Ori Nakamura: hey folks! ori here — joining as an SRE (joining from boston). big into sailing, amateur cheddar-making, and deliberately bad ukulele covers :wave:
Mara Singh: welcome ori!! excited to have you. when do you start on-site?
Ori Nakamura: starting monday 10am. badge is still in the mail so i'll be badgeless for the first day — badge request was submitted but wanted to flag it here in case building folks need a heads-up.
Jules Becker: :tada: welcome! we usually gather in the kitchen around 10:15 for coffee, i'll grab a spare temporary lanyard if you need one. also curious — do you want a window seat or a quieter corner?
Ori Nakamura: window seat please if available. i'm terrible at office plants so trade offers welcome (i do however make a mean grilled cheese if that counts)
Alex Cho: window seat swap possible — i'd happily trade for a small leafy friend. i'm also rostered for donuts next Friday if you want to put in a ukulele request with your keyboard backstory :D
AccessBot: Temporary visitor badge issued for Ori Nakamura. Expires in 8 hours. Badge code: VIS-4315 (please return to security desk when your permanent badge arrives).
WelcomeBot: Welcome to Redwood Inference, Ori! If you haven’t yet, join the #eng-ride-share and #lunch-plans channels. There’s a quick onboarding checklist in your DMs.
Mara Singh: oh also — sticker request? if you want a tiny sailboat for your laptop desk, ping me and i'll get one from the swag box.
Ori Nakamura: sold on the sailboat sticker. thanks y'all — see you monday 10am near the third-floor coffee station :coffee:
